name: Catan
description: Players collect resources and build roads, settlements, and cities to dominate the island of Catan through trading and expansion.

name: Ticket to Ride
description: Players collect train cards to claim railway routes across a map, connecting cities to complete tickets and score points.

name: Carcassonne
description: Players place tiles to build a medieval landscape and deploy followers to score points from cities, roads, and farms.

name: Pandemic
description: A cooperative game where players work together as specialists to stop global disease outbreaks before humanity collapses.

name: 7 Wonders
description: A card drafting game where players build civilizations and construct wonders.

name: Gloomhaven
description: A tactical campaign game with dungeon crawling and card-driven combat.

name: Azul
description: Players draft tiles to decorate a palace wall and score points.

name: Dixit
description: A storytelling game using imaginative clues and surreal artwork.

name: Scythe
description: An engine-building game set in alternate-history Europe.

name: Exploding Kittens
description: A quick card game where players avoid drawing exploding kittens.

name: Terraforming Mars
description: Players develop Mars by building infrastructure and raising global parameters.

name: Brass: Birmingham
description: An economic strategy game about building industries in England.

name: Wingspan
description: Players attract birds to wildlife preserves to build powerful combos.

name: Root
description: An asymmetric strategy game where factions compete for forest control.

name: Spirit Island
description: Players are spirits defending their island from colonizers.

name: Dominion
description: A deck-building game where players construct their card engine.

name: Splendor
description: Players collect gems to purchase developments and attract nobles.

name: Love Letter
description: A deduction card game about delivering a letter to the princess.

name: The Resistance
description: A social deduction game of hidden roles and secret missions.

name: Codenames
description: Teams compete to guess words using one-word clues.

name: Patchwork
description: A two-player game about building the best quilt.

name: King of Tokyo
description: Players are monsters battling for control of Tokyo.

name: Dead of Winter
description: A survival game set during a zombie apocalypse.

name: Ark Nova
description: Players build and manage a modern zoo.

name: Everdell
description: A worker placement game set in a charming forest world.

name: Agricola
description: Players develop farms and manage resources.

name: Betrayal at House on the Hill
description: Exploration game where one player betrays the others mid-game.

name: Sheriff of Nottingham
description: Players bluff and smuggle goods past the sheriff.

name: Small World
description: Fantasy races compete to control a small, crowded world.

name: Power Grid
description: Players compete to supply electricity to cities.
